description: Original fictional steampunk and gaslamp names, inventions, airships, guilds, districts, automatons, headlines and oracles.

provenance.title: Steampunk & gaslamp synthetic corpus
provenance.creator: LexiconLang contributors
provenance.attribution: All strings in this pack are original synthetic fiction authored for LexiconLang. No real living people, trademarks or setting-specific IP are reproduced.

grammars.description: Airship names, from workaday cargo haulers to grand passenger liners.
Inventions and contraptions bearing maker names or model marks.
Trade guilds, engineering societies and chartered associations.
Learned societies, clubs and civic associations of the gaslamp age.
Newspaper headlines in the style of a fictional gaslamp-era press.
Districts and neighbourhoods within a soot-and-brass metropolis.
Automaton designations and functions, from domestic help to civic sentries.
Patent application titles for spurious but plausible inventions.
Civic ranks, official titles and guild offices.

tables.description: A documentary-style fault oracle for invented machines; no real product or IP.

result.text: A harmless hiss of steam; the operator turns red.
A valve sticks. The machine proceeds at half pace.
The escapement loses four minutes an hour.
A belt snaps and flails; everyone ducks.

tables.description: Fictional street omens and encounters for a gaslamp district.

result.text: A lamplighter tips his hat and knows your name.
The tower clock strikes thirteen; nobody else reacts.
A warm brass coin sits on the cobbles, minted next year.
A courier steps from the fog with a sealed envelope.
An automaton offers to carry your parcels, politely, forever.
An inspector asks to see your boiler licence.
A newspaper seller shouts a headline that has not happened yet.
For one block, the street is entirely silent.
A gas lantern burns blue and then goes out.
Night-shift riveters are singing a marching tune.
Your shadow arrives half a second after you do.
A tea stall is open, and the vendor has been expecting you.
